question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It was a __privvilege __to receive the award from the President.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **privilege**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"privvilege"** is misspelled. The correct spelling is **"privilege".** (विशेषाधिकार)

 
 
• **Example: **It was a privvilege to receive the award from the President.
 
 
 
• **"Privilege"** refers to a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार)
 
 
• **Example: **Having access to quality education is considered a **privilege.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
